facts.claim: The town was named Fraserpet in honor of General Fraser, the first Commissioner of Coorg.
facts.quote: The town was named ^Fraserpet'' in honor of General Fraser, the first Commissioner of Coorg.

facts.claim: It contains 326 houses, mostly tiled, and a population of 1,213 people, including 360 Christians, 388 Mussulmans and 465 Hindus.
facts.quote: It contains now 326 houses, mostly tiled, and a population of 1,213 souls, of whom 360 are Christians, 388 Mussulmans and 465 Hindus.

facts.claim: Every Monday there is a market, which gives the place its name.
facts.quote: Every Monday there is market, hence the name of the place.
